No captured messages yet.

To capture WhatsApp messages:
1. Enable notification access in settings
2. Enable the "Capture messages" toggle in the menu

WhatsApp Message Capture:

This feature captures WhatsApp messages from system notifications and stores them locally on your device. No data is sent to any server or external service.

Limitations:
- Only captures messages from notifications
- No media content (images, videos, etc.)
- No past messages
- Does not decrypt WhatsApp databases

You can disable capture and clear all stored messages at any time from the app menu.

This is for educational purposes only.
Please grant notification access in settings
